finalText:
Confirmed: 5 two-argument calls in `quarterly.js`, matching my grep count.

**17 call sites** across the repo still pass the second argument to `formatAmount`, and `src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with **5**.

The rest are spread thin: `admin/exports.js` and `billing/invoice.js` have 3 each, `checkout/cart.js` and `reports/monthly.js` have 2 each, and `billing/statement.js` and `checkout/receipt.js` have 1 each. `admin/dashboard.js`, `billing/refunds.js`, and `reports/ledger.js` don't use the flag at all.
